name: capital-com-mcp
description: Market data, account management, position tracking, and order execution via the Capital.com Open API.

CAP_ENV.title: Environment
CAP_ENV.description: demo = practice account, live = real money.

CAP_API_KEY.title: API Key
CAP_API_KEY.description: Your Capital.com API key. Generate at: Settings > API integrations > Generate new key.

CAP_DRY_RUN.title: Dry Run Mode
CAP_DRY_RUN.description: When enabled, all trade executions are refused. Useful for testing the trading flow without real orders.

CAP_IDENTIFIER.title: Email (Identifier)
CAP_IDENTIFIER.description: Your Capital.com account email address used to log in.

CAP_WS_ENABLED.title: Enable WebSocket Streaming
CAP_WS_ENABLED.description: Enable real-time price streaming tools via WebSocket. Sessions last 10 minutes max with auto-reconnect.

CAP_API_PASSWORD.title: API Password
CAP_API_PASSWORD.description: Your Capital.com API key custom password (not your platform login password).

CAP_ALLOWED_EPICS.title: Allowed EPICs
CAP_ALLOWED_EPICS.description: Which instruments trading is allowed on. 'ALL' (the default) permits every instrument. To restrict, replace it with a comma-separated list of EPICs (e.g. SILVER,GOLD,BTCUSD). Leaving this empty is not the same as 'ALL': with trading enabled, the server refuses to start.

CAP_ALLOW_TRADING.title: Allow Trading
CAP_ALLOW_TRADING.description: Enable trading operations. When false, only read-only tools (market data, account info) are available.
